findings.reason: the bar must be restated so the control is judged on a criterion it can actually fail (for example on the ≥5-row and ≥20-point clauses alone, with the control comparison applied only to the candidate signals), otherwise the control measures nothing and §33 cannot report the unreliable-sample verdict its done-when requires.
findings.text: §33 defines a separating signal as one whose lowest- and highest-bucket pass rates differ "by at least 20 percentage points and by more than the control signal's difference at that requirement"; applied to the done-when's own declared negative control (the parity of the run id's timestamp seconds) that clause compares the control's difference with itself, so the control can never clear the bar, and done-when clause 2 ("Where the control itself clears the bar at a requirement, the document says that requirement's sample cannot rank signals and names no separating signal there", line 262) can never fire — the section's only negative control is unreachable

findings.reason: §33 must state that it measures the picker's present counting until §35 lands, rather than citing a replaced rule, or §33's figures will be read as the plan's own and contradict §35.
findings.text: §33's Why justifies leaving the 9 lane-change rows out of codex's own outcomes with "Under §4 of jev-learns-from-its-routes those rows count in `moved_in`, not in codex's own outcomes", but the decision `reasoned-move-evidence` in this same snapshot (line 314, `data-choice="split-by-attempt"`, locked 2026-10-18T11:13:09Z) states at line 321 "This replaces §4 of jev-learns-from-its-routes", and §35 (line 275) confirms the plan's rule is now that each attempt "counts for the lane that ran it" — so §33 cites an authority its own document has retired, and the deliverable's population ("moved rows are left out", via `_picked_backend_away`) is the counting the decision rejects

findings.reason: adding `"s34": ["lane-and-model-routing#s33"]` is a one-line change that makes the roadmap hold §34 behind §33, which the prose declaration alone cannot do.
findings.text: the `plan-section-depends-on` meta declares no entry for `s34`, although §34 (line 269) states it "stays deferred until §33 names a signal, because conditioning on a guessed signal would split thin samples further" and its deliverable conditions on "the size bucket §33 chose", so §34's only declared prerequisite is a prose sentence the roadmap does not read
